messages:
akshay: quick heads-up — planning a canary rollout for model v3.2. target: Mon 08:00 UTC activation for alpha slice. async signoff requested on pct/regional split, alerts, and rollback gates. will start very small and iterate.

maria: SG. what's the initial slice plan? pls include eval/regression checks for hallucination + safety.

akshay: rough plan below (will put formal YAML into the repo):
```
slices:
  - id: alpha
    pct: 1
    regions: [us-east-1]
  - id: gamma
    pct: 8
    regions: [us-east-1, eu-west-1]
  - id: hold
    pct: 91
    regions: [global]
```
alpha for 24h, gamma 36-48h, then conditional ramp. fallback pinned to model v3.1.

lee: need an explicit kill-switch + exact command and who is authorized to run it. add the runbook link too.

akshay: kill-switch (internal CLI): `rfd toggle --feature model_v3_2 --slice alpha --pct 0` -> removes canary traffic. only owners + eng-platform-sre allowed. runbook: https://confluence.redwood/company/runbooks/model-rollout-ops

sre-bot: REQUIRED ALERTS: error_rate:1m, p99_latency:5m, model_quality_regression (eval job). Must be active before any ramp.

olivia: gating thresholds proposal:
- error rate +0.25% abs OR +50% rel -> pause
- p99 > 350ms for 10m -> pause
- eval hallucination increase > 1.5% -> rollback
Also block if downstream 5xx trend increases.

maria: add per-slice tracing, token-cost delta, memory OOM alerts, and a sample bucket for human review (store outputs for ~7 days). capture 2% of canary requests.

akshay: ok will enable 2% sample to secure blob (private). samples tagged by slice + request id.

lee: who is on pager for the first 48h? propose: akshay (owner), lee (sre), maria (ml), olivia (pq). confirm.

olivia: I can take QA oversight first 24h.

maria: confirmed for eval checks first 48h.

akshay: thanks. i'll post a preflight checklist tomorrow and create the staging toggle. if no objections by EOD i'll schedule alpha for Mon 08:00 UTC.

lee: +1. also ensure toggle entitlement is scoped to a small group and that audit logs are enabled for toggle actions.

sre-bot: PRELFIGHT VALIDATION: feature flag role-checks OK (restricted to eng-platform-sre + eng-ml leads). alert hooks configured.

olivia: one more: add a per-slice hourly token quota to cap cost automatically (fail-open? fail-closed? recommend fail-closed for alpha).

maria: add a lightweight post-rollout notes template for quick PM/eng notes in case of rollback. keep it <30m to fill.

akshay: will do all the above and attach runbook + toggle command outputs here once created. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: REMINDER: schedule synthetic traffic against alpha for the first 90min to validate latency and error surface under load.

akshay: synthetic load scheduled. i'll update timestamps and post the staging toggle command when ready.

lee: will monitor the window. ping if anything odd.

akshay: thanks team — proceeding unless new objections.
